light_description: Original Ovaltone drive introduced in 2014; documented three-mode DISTORTION/VINTAGE/OVERDRIVE operation and a three-position mid emphasis selector on the full version.
Reduced-function production version of GD-013 with simplified controls and fixed HONK/DIST behavior; retained as a meaningful production state rather than a new conceptual family.
2017 successor to GD-013 with revised response, increased gain/fat range and DIST/VIN/O.D. modes; official discontinued page provides extensive exterior photography and controls.
Dual-channel Ovaltone high-gain drive/distortion platform with extensive documented artist use; retained as a central historical dirt model.
2021 professional custom development based on OD-FIVE 2 eXplosion, with independent low/mid/high-gain modes on each channel; later discontinued in 2023.
2016 British-amplifier-oriented drive/distortion with three-way VOICE and three-way channel selection; official page documents gain behavior and exterior product presentation.
Original 2016 Fountain overdrive; later replaced by a 2025 redesigned generation. Historical production should remain distinct from the current version.
2025 redesign of Fountain with increased headroom and clarity plus PRE GAIN/FAT/CLIP controls; official page gives release date, controls and production details.
2025 signature variant based on Fountain 2025 ver. with an additional hard-clipping stage and more distortion-oriented response; retained as a distinct signature edition relationship.
2025 compact British-style drive derived from the 34-Xtreme target but completely redesigned; official page documents gain, EQ and narrow-mid boost control.

2024 Ovaltone recreation/modification of a black metal enclosure distortion reference, with dual amplification and revised tone/clipping behavior; official page provides product photos and detailed description.
2026 fuzz/distortion with GAIN, VOLUME, TONE, POST BASS, BASS CUT and MORE controls; official product page and current shop provide exterior photographs.
2025 first Ovaltone design explicitly dedicated to bass, ranging from subtle saturation through blended drive to fuzz-like gain; official page documents 30V internal operation and product imagery.
2023 drive based on the sound target of a 1990s amplifier head, combining drive and booster sections; revision 1.2 became the standard from February 2024.
Ovaltone modified Tube Screamer platform with broader dynamic response and lowered-drive range; official historical page places it in the 2022 product line.
Paired Ovaltone Tube Screamer modification with its own documented response tuning; retained separately from -9 as a named product.
2024 Shimamura-limited collaboration with Susumu Tamura, centered on a modified 808 design and documented as a distinct product model.
2022 mini drive with simple DRIVE/VOLUME controls, intentionally spanning low to medium gain and designed as a compact member of Ovaltone's reduced-enclosure series.
2023 return to the original Merkava concept with revised controls and upgraded enclosure/parts, combining booster behavior with standalone overdrive use.
Japanese handmade high-gain drive introduced in 2021; official page documents Level/Gain/3EQ, BITE and PLEXI modes plus exterior image set.
Drive/preamp version of the Jackal family with NORMAL and PREAMP modes, three-band EQ and bright switching; official page provides product photography and detailed controls.
JACKAL MIDNIGHT variant with Clean Blend, clean LPF and clean volume controls; retained as a substantive product variant but not a separate conceptual family.
Modern Japanese fuzz tuned for fast response and usable low-end shaping, with GAIN/VOLUME/WEIGHT controls and a bypassable weight circuit; official page provides full exterior photos and specs.

Historical Limetone Audio overdrive product; first-party news records its production ending January 2021. Retained as a historical dirt model even though its product page is no longer in the current catalog.
